name: Saving the Best for Last
label: Quest
description: Saving the Best for Last: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: That's an amazing story, friend! You have my thanks, and the heartfelt gratitude of all who were involved. Now maybe I'll be able to sleep at night with both eyes shut.
As to your reward, I believe I have a few things that you'll really enjoy.

clips.title: Progress
paras: As per our deal, are you ready to hand over your Dreadmist pieces in exchange for your new Deathmist Mask and Robe?

clips.title: Completion
paras: I'm going to miss you, friend. I owe you such a debt of gratitude; I think I'll never be able to repay it.
I hope that you enjoy your new head and chest armor, and that it protects you for a long time to come.
